Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. expand, frontier ordering, costs and show_chain remain nested. The diagram
assumes a positive result limit: this wrapper checks batch but does not reject
zero/negative limit, and the nearest branch indexes near[limit-1]. Source review does not
establish global optimality under fan/hop limits. Source review only; no Engine command
